private.is_hospital_provider
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_hospital_provider(p_provider_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.providers
    WHERE id = p_provider_id
      AND (
        category_id = 'clinics'
        OR category_id = 'hospital'
        OR category_id ILIKE '%clinic%'
        OR category_id ILIKE '%hospital%'
      )
  );
END;
$function$

name: private.get_active_cities
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_active_cities(p_include_expanding boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, state text, status text, latitude numeric, longitude numeric, radius_km numeric, active_providers_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.state,
    c.status,
    c.latitude,
    c.longitude,
    c.radius_km,
    COUNT(p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE')::BIGINT AS active_providers_count
  FROM public.cities c
  LEFT JOIN public.providers p ON p.city_id = c.id
  WHERE (c.status = 'ACTIVE') OR (p_include_expanding AND c.status = 'EXPANDING')
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.state, c.status, c.latitude, c.longitude, c.radius_km
  ORDER BY (CASE WHEN c.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), c.name ASC;
END;
$function$

private.search_directory_public
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.search_directory_public(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_results jsonb;
  v_sanitized_query text;
BEGIN
  v_sanitized_query := substr(trim(COALESCE(p_query, '')), 1, 100);

  IF v_sanitized_query = '' THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', p.id,
          'name', p.name,
          'category_id', p.category_id,
          'address', p.address,
          'city', p.city,
          'opening_time', p.opening_time,
          'closing_time', p.closing_time,
          'description', p.description,
          'photos', p.photos,
          'latitude', p.latitude,
          'longitude', p.longitude,
          'status', p.status,
          'resources', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'id', r.id,
                'provider_id', r.provider_id,
                'name', r.name,
                'type', r.type,
                'department', r.department,
                'department_id', r.department_id,
                'deposit_amount', r.deposit_amount,
                'duration_minutes', r.duration_minutes,
                'capacity', r.capacity,
                'is_active', r.is_active
              )
            ) FROM public.resources r WHERE r.provider_id = p.id AND r.is_active = true),
            '[]'::jsonb
          )
        )
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_results
    FROM public.providers p
    WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE';
    RETURN v_results;
  END IF;

  WITH matched_providers AS (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.name,
      p.category_id,
      p.address,
      p.city,
      p.opening_time,
      p.closing_time,
      p.description,
      p.photos,
      p.latitude,
      p.longitude,
      p.status,
      GREATEST(
        extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, p.name),
        extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, COALESCE(p.description, '')),
        COALESCE(MAX(extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, r.name)), 0),
        COALESCE(MAX(extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, COALESCE(r.department, ''))), 0)
      ) AS relevance
    FROM public.providers p
    LEFT JOIN public.resources r ON r.provider_id = p.id
    WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (
        p.name ILIKE '%' || v_sanitized_query || '%'
        OR COALESCE(p.description, '') ILIKE '%' || v_sanitized_query || '%'
        OR r.name ILIKE '%' || v_sanitized_query || '%'
        OR COALESCE(r.department, '') ILIKE '%' || v_sanitized_query || '%'
        OR extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, p.name) > 0.3
        OR extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, COALESCE(r.name, '')) > 0.3
        OR extensions.word_similarity(v_sanitized_query, COALESCE(r.department, '')) > 0.3
      )
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category_id, p.address, p.city, p.opening_time, p.closing_time, p.description, p.photos, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.status
    ORDER BY relevance DESC
    LIMIT 50
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', mp.id,
        'name', mp.name,
        'category_id', mp.category_id,
        'address', mp.address,
        'city', mp.city,
        'opening_time', mp.opening_time,
        'closing_time', mp.closing_time,
        'description', mp.description,
        'photos', mp.photos,
        'latitude', mp.latitude,
        'longitude', mp.longitude,
        'status', mp.status,
        'resources', COALESCE(
          (SELECT jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', r.id,
              'provider_id', r.provider_id,
              'name', r.name,
              'type', r.type,
              'department', r.department,
              'department_id', r.department_id,
              'deposit_amount', r.deposit_amount,
              'duration_minutes', r.duration_minutes,
              'capacity', r.capacity,
              'is_active', r.is_active
            )
          ) FROM public.resources r WHERE r.provider_id = mp.id AND r.is_active = true),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
      )
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_results
  FROM matched_providers mp;

  RETURN v_results;
END;
$function$
